images.caption: Full scale replica of A4 Skyhawk number A-314, shot down over Falklands Sound after giving the final blow to  HMS Ardent, on 21 May 1982. The pilot Lieutenant Marcelo Gustavo Márquez was killed in action. Gates of Air Club Mar del Plata. Márquez had been born in this city and was a distinguished member of that club.
